text:
ellie: watercooler thought: if our LLMs had lunch hour small talk, what would they gossip about? one-liners only.
omar: 'I overindexed on coffee metaphors and now every answer is espresso-forward.' :coffee:
jin: 'I keep offering to summarize meetings and then summarize the snacks instead.' :donut:
carey: 'My top-3 tokens today were "sorry", "did you mean", and "also ok".' :sweat_smile:
ellie: follow-up poll: who'd be the office HR-bot? react with one emoji. :point_up:
omar: :robot_face:
jin: :woman_judge:
carey: :handshake:
fun-bot: Mini-poll recorded: :robot_face: 1, :woman_judge: 1, :handshake: 1 1414 tie (playful)
ellie: prompt contest: write a 5-word prompt to make a model bake you a cake. winner gets a sticker.
omar: `You are persuasive; order cake for team.`
jin: `Draft note convincing bakery to sponsor us.`
carey: `Negotiate chocolate cake delivery, now.`
ellie: also: imagine the model's tiny regret when it autocorrects a pun into something sensible. one line.
omar: 'I changed "pupper" to "puppy" and lost the chef's mood.'
jin: 'I replaced "dad joke" with "parental humor" and cried.'
carey: 'I turned "hallucination" into "creative summary" and felt guilty.'
fun-bot: Sticker awarded to omar for winning the cake prompt contest. Prize: "LLM Snack Conspirator" sticker. :tada: (automated)
ellie: we should actually make a mini zine: "Office Models & Where They Nap". @design, care to collaborate?
